transaction.finalization: Only after Read completes header, raw finish/counters, CRC/ISIZE and EOF, pending SHA is computed, hash sink is disposed, optional test hook runs, and shared budget/cancellation is checked. Boundary and optional hash are then committed once.
transaction.failure: exception propagates; no committed boundary/hash; one-use wrapper cannot retry; local default inflater is abandoned, no reset/reuse
transaction.selectedFalse: full parse/decode/CRC/ISIZE/budget/EOF checks; no sink output, no selected hash; successful boundary only
transaction.publication: no filesystem output, temp archive, rename, ValidatedArchive, or product file publication is implemented
transaction.rollback: no inflater rollback claim; only final result withholding

budgets.accounting: Input high-water/read-ahead accounting is unchanged. Every Inflate call records its observable TotalOut delta in finally before exception propagation or post-call cancellation/time checks. Successful output is not charged twice. Selected output is charged only on the existing sink delivery path. Repeated attempts share the same budget without reset/refund.
budgets.time: same start and TimeProvider through parse, hashing, disposal and final check; cooperative checks cannot interrupt synchronous decoder call
budgets.failedOutput: TotalOut measures bytes copied into the caller output buffer, including bytes copied by a call that subsequently throws. It does not expose bytes still held only inside OutputWindow. No decoder internals are modified.
budgets.overLimit: Record actual bounded output delta even when it exceeds ProcessedLimit; then throw Budget. Processed may exceed the configured limit by at most 65536 and remains recorded. Check rejects later attempts. A valid delta that exceeds the budget takes precedence over an Inflate exception; invalid negative/oversized delta produces Boundary. Otherwise preserve Deflate/cancellation/original exception.
